security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob: asset: http://asset.localhost; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost https://api.open-meteo.com https://geocoding-api.open-meteo.com; media-src 'self' blob:

bundle.shortDescription: A calm island at the top of your screen.
bundle.longDescription: Atoll is a free, open-source island for your desktop: clock, focus timer, clipboard history, system stats, app launcher, media and power controls, wallpapers, and optional AI with your own Gemini key or local Ollama.
